role: Pins that every regex DebugLogger's log redactor and MetricsVerifier use compiles (they fail open on a malformed pattern), by keeping a verbatim copy, rebuilding the two runtime-composed patterns, and scraping raw-string literals from the source files at test time; and asserts what DebugLogger.scrubPHI actually leaves of sample log lines.
types: RedactionPatternTests: class — XCTestCase for DebugLogger redaction pattern compilation
state: mem:RedactionPatternTests.patterns (4 verbatim copies of DebugLog.swift's raw-string patterns: lat/lon, metric names incl. \w*score, unit, separator)
toplevel: Static lets hold copied patterns and source paths. Tests read production .swift files from disk relative to #filePath, so they only work when the test bundle runs on the machine holding the source tree.

units.does: Asserts each of the 4 copied redaction patterns compiles with NSRegularExpression.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

branches.effect: XCTAssertNoThrow per pattern; loop over 4 entries

units.does: Rebuilds the value-chain regex the way redactValueChains does (DebugLog.swift:379) with the unit pattern and asserts it compiles with (?i) prefix.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Rebuilds scrubPHI's main pattern the way DebugLogger composes it ((?i)(\b<metric>\b<separator>)[-+]?\d+(?:\.\d+)?<unit>, from patterns[1], [3] and [2]) and asserts it compiles.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts DebugLogger.scrubPHI's output on six lines: 'RMSSD: 42.5 ms' → 'RMSSD: <redacted>', an arrow chain 'RMSSD 42.0→51.3' → both values redacted, 'score=72.00' and camel-case 'frozenScore=55.20' redacted, lat/lon values redacted, and 'session 3 started' left untouched.
units.entry: XCTest runner: test method on an XCTestCase subclass

units.does: Asserts DebugLogger.compiledPattern returns nil for '([unterminated' and non-nil for '\d+'.

units.does: Calls compiledPattern twice with the same pattern and asserts both regexes have the same .pattern string.

units.does: Reads DebugLog.swift from disk, scrapes every #"..."# raw-string literal, asserts at least one was found and that each is in Self.patterns.
